# Q3 Planning Meeting Summary — 2026-08-27

## Key Decisions & Points

### Reconciliation Revamp (Q3 Anchor)
- Current engine chokes on multi-currency batches; 3 incidents this quarter, support tickets up 40% QoQ
- Rewrite scoped at ~6 engineer-weeks, includes FX rounding module migration
- Requires Karim from platform for 2 weeks (ledger integration)
- Build-vs-buy evaluated: Recur ($180K/yr) and LedgerFlow ($140K/yr, but lacks jurisdiction-specific tax codes) both rejected — build wins
- **Decision:** Reconciliation is the Q3 anchor project

### Mobile Receipt-Capture
- Design flows done; prototype tested with 6 users
- User testing surfaced two needs: bulk-select before upload, and more prominent OCR confidence indicator
- Bulk-select would add ~1 sprint — descoped from v1
- **Decision:** Ship v1 without bulk-select; add bulk-select as a fast-follow on the roadmap

### Vendor Payout SLA
- Finance wants 48-hour payout guarantee from invoice approval; current p95 is 71 hours
- Two bottlenecks: manual approval routing (ops) and 12-hour ACH batching window (eng)
- Proposal: cut ACH batching window from 12h to 4h + add west-coast shift second approver → 48h p95 by mid-Q3
- ACH change costs ~half a sprint of eng time plus SRE sign-off (more ACH files/day, more monitoring overhead)
- **Decision:** Pending trade-off analysis next week; proceed if SRE says monitoring load is manageable, otherwise consider intermediate targets

### Other Items
- Audit-log retention update pushed to Q4 (confirmed with Legal)
- Internal admin-tool refresh stays with the intern crew — no changes
- HR flagged bug-bash burnout on engineering; a rotating on-call proposal is needed
